the application of acoustic wave physics in the study of neuronal cells.
developing a new method for monitoring the electrical activity in neuronal cells.

the TSM acoustic wave sensor does not solely measure the membrane potential, but rather the membrane potential and other changes associated with the depolariation process.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TSM device can be used to monitor the depolarization of surface attached neurons.

the TSM device is a viable tool for the study of the electrical properties of neuronal cells.

TSM sensors have potential for the study of the action of hormones, neurotransmitters, and other agents on the structure and function of cells.
